parameters.name: sizePage
parameters.description: Items per page. Use `0` to retrieve only the count without fetching any item — faster when you only need the total.

schema.description:
Type of a feature.

* `OnOff` — boolean feature (module access, content access, etc.)
* `Limitation` — counted feature whose quantity is NOT reset at renewal
* `Consumption` — counted feature whose quantity IS reset at each renewal
schema.title: TypeFeature

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: Sub-resources to embed in the response.
